dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of that, why didn't you help Mihir earlier, Sorush?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you just lent a little power to the thorns, you could've done that even without our help, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: This is my duty, not hers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? But shouldn't you help each other out at times like this?

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Each Pari has their own mission, and just like this cleansing pilgrimage, we must undertake those tasks ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Missions and duties... all have someone they belong to, and we cannot allow others to take over completely.
